name: Toxicologist
summary: Toxicologists specialize in the stealthy application of insidious poisons to their targets, believing word of their foes’ horrifying deaths will deter others from attempting similar desecrations of the natural world.
replacesText: Spontaneous Casting; Wild Empathy; Woodland Stride; Trackless Step; Resist Nature's Lure; Wild Shape

features.name: Expanded Repertoire (Ex)
features.summary: A toxicologist adds the following extracts and spells to her druid spell list as druid spells of the listed spell level: poisoned egg (1st level, Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Gods 238 ), transmute potion to poisonAPG (2nd level), stinking cloud (3rd level), toxic giftUM (4th level), and cloudkill (5th level). A toxicologist can channel stored spell energy only into summoning spells she has prepared ahead of time. This ability alters spells and replaces spontaneous casting.

progressionProfiles.label: Expanded Repertoire

values.spells: Poisoned Egg (1st); Transmute Potion to Poison (2nd); Stinking Cloud (3rd); Toxic Gift (4th); Cloudkill (5th)

progressionProfiles.summary: All five spells are in the Druid catalogue at their published levels. Spontaneous conversion is restricted to summoning spells that were prepared ahead of time.

features.name: Natural Poison Lore (Ex)
features.summary: A toxicologist has a deep understanding of and appreciation for poisons. At 2nd level, she cannot accidentally poison herself when applying poison to a weapon and cannot accidentally poison an animal companion or summoned creature when applying poison to its claws (though poison obviously should not be applied to a creature’s bite). This ability replaces wild empathy and woodland stride.

progressionProfiles.label: Natural Poison Lore

values.safeTargets: Self when poisoning a weapon; animal companion or summoned creature when poisoning claws (never bites)

progressionProfiles.summary: The listed accidental-poisoning risks are removed automatically; the bite restriction remains explicit.

features.name: Expert Poisoner (Su)
features.summary: At 4th level, a toxicologist increases the DCs of any spells she casts with the poison descriptor by 1. This ability replaces trackless step and resist nature’s lure.

features.name: Toxic Shaper (Su)
features.summary: A toxicologist never gains the ability to use wild shape to transform into an elemental or plant. At 8th level, a toxicologist can transform into a Small or Medium vermin. When she takes this form, her wild shape functions as vermin shape IUM . At 10th level, a toxicologist can transform into a tiny or large vermin. When she takes this form, her wild shape functions as vermin shape IIUM . This ability alters wild shape.

progressionProfiles.label: Toxic Shaper progression

values.vermin: Small or Medium via vermin shape I
Tiny, Small, Medium, or Large via vermin shape II

progressionProfiles.summary: The Wild Shape control exposes only forms legal at the current Druid level.

features.name: Wild Shape (Altered)
features.summary: A toxicologist retains animal wild shape, never unlocks elemental or plant forms, and adds vermin shape forms through Toxic Shaper at levels 8 and 10.

resourceActions.label: Assume Toxicologist Wild Shape

activeEffect.name: Toxicologist Wild Shape
activeEffect.description: Assume the selected legal animal or vermin form. Elemental and plant forms are prohibited.

resourceActions.summary: Spend one Wild Shape use; the legal tier and exact 1-hour-per-level duration are calculated automatically.

mechanicalNotes: All five added spells, prepared-only summoning conversion, safe poison application rules, poison-descriptor save DC increase, retained animal Wild Shape, added vermin tiers, prohibited elemental/plant forms, and exact duration are automated.
